Package index

Charts

Every chart function returns an htmlwidget rendered by the bundled D3.js v7 - interactive, animated, and theme-aware. All of them share the same title/subtitle/mode/source options.

Interactive D3 bar chart
pv_line()
Interactive D3 line chart
pv_area()
Interactive D3 area chart

Interactive D3 scatter plot

pv_pack()

Chart layers & linking

Pipe-able modifiers - annotations, fitted trends, texture fills, small multiples, and crosstalk selection linking - that layer onto an existing chart.

pv_annotate()
Annotate a cartesian polyviz chart
pv_hline() pv_vline() pv_band() pv_note()
Annotation layers for polyviz charts
pv_trend()
Add a fitted trend to a scatter or line chart
pv_textures()
Texture fills as a second identity channel
pv_facet()
Facet a chart into small multiples
pv_link()
Link a chart into a crosstalk selection group

Papers & export

Getting charts out of the browser and onto a page - print-quality PNG/SVG/PDF, animated GIFs of the race, self-contained HTML files, whole PowerPoint decks, plus the in-chart download control. (Knitting to Word or PDF needs no function call at all - a chart in a chunk becomes a figure by itself.)

pv_save()
Save a chart as PNG, SVG, PDF, GIF, or self-contained HTML
pv_deck()
Save a list of charts as a PowerPoint deck
pv_downloads()
Toggle a chart's download control
pv_static()
Render a chart as a still figure

Alt text

Every chart carries a generated description of itself, for screen readers and knitted documents - read it, or replace it with your own words.

pv_alt_text()
The generated description of a chart
pv_alt()
Set a chart's alt text by hand

Data in & out

One reader that dispatches on file extension, plus direct access to the SQLite and SAS backends.

pv_read()
Read data from any supported source
pv_read_sas()
Read a SAS dataset
pv_write_sas()
Write a SAS dataset
pv_labels()
Get variable labels
pv_set_labels()
Set variable labels
pv_db_connect()
Connect to a SQLite database
pv_db_disconnect()
Disconnect from a database
pv_db_write()
Write a data frame to a database table
pv_db_tables()
List tables in a database
pv_query()
Run a SQL query and return the result
pv_run_sql_file()
Execute a SQL script file

Swiss open data

Live access to the portals the bundled datasets come from - search the opendata.swiss catalogue, fetch from the BFS and LUSTAT, pull the country-wide boundary layers, and manage the shared download cache. Every fetch states its source and licence terms.

pv_search_opendata()
Search datasets on opendata.swiss
pv_fetch_opendata()
Fetch a dataset's CSV data from opendata.swiss
pv_fetch_bfs()
Fetch a dataset from the Swiss Federal Statistical Office (stats.swiss)
pv_fetch_lustat()
Fetch a dataset from LUSTAT Statistik Luzern
pv_fetch_map()
Fetch a Switzerland-wide boundary layer from the BFS
pv_cache_status() pv_cache_clear()
Inspect polyviz's open-data download cache

Analysis

Summaries, numeric profiling (Python-backed when available, pure R otherwise), outlier flags, and the one-call HTML report.

pv_summary()
Summarise a data frame
pv_profile()
Profile the numeric columns of a data frame
pv_outliers()
Flag outliers in a numeric vector
pv_py_available()
Is the Python backend available?
pv_plot_corr()
Correlation heatmap
pv_plot_missing()
Missingness plot
pv_report()
One-call HTML report of a data frame
pv_demo()
Launch the polyviz demo gallery

Theming & locale

The packaged colour tokens, palette accessors and ggplot2 scales, the session theme API with its accessibility checker, the print-first paper theme, and locale-aware number and date formatting.

pv_colors
polyviz colour tokens
pv_palette()
Categorical palette
pv_set_theme()
Set a session-wide polyviz theme
pv_reset_theme()
Reset the polyviz theme
pv_theme_paper()
A print-first theme for the printed page
pv_check_palette() print(<pv_palette_check>)
Check a categorical palette for accessibility
pv_locale()
Set a session-wide chart locale
scale_colour_pv() scale_color_pv() scale_fill_pv()
ggplot2 scales using the polyviz palette
theme_polyviz()
polyviz ggplot2 theme

Datasets

Bundled demonstration data - simulated sales and networks, plus real Swiss open data (cities, commuters, Lucerne fiscal equalization, elections, boundaries, weather, electricity, and tourism).

Simulated monthly sales
pv_network

pv_flows
Simulated inter-warehouse shipment flows
pv_city_population

pv_city_landuse

pv_commuters

pv_fiscal
Fiscal equalization of Lucerne municipalities
pv_elections

pv_lucerne_map

pv_swiss_cantons

pv_swiss_districts

pv_swiss_lakes

pv_city_coords

pv_weather

pv_electricity
Monthly Swiss electricity production by source
pv_tourism
Hotel nights in Swiss cantons by guest origin
